passage: Huge offseason for the Ridgeback Rovers! We signed the top scorer from the Valley League, the best goalkeeper in the county and two all-star midfielders. With the best player we could find at every position, this has to be our championship year. Rec league, consider yourselves warned. First match is Sunday at 10.
cue: With the best player we could find at every position, this has to be our championship year
explanation: Tariq assumes a team of strong individuals must be the strongest team. Teamwork, fit and chemistry belong to the team as a whole, so great parts don't guarantee a great side.

whyNot.fal_hasty_generalization: Tariq isn't stretching a few examples to a whole group; he's assuming the players' individual quality automatically adds up to the team's.

title: Nothing but goodness in every bite
passage: Oats. Honey. Dates. Almonds. Coconut oil. Every ingredient in our Meadowgrain Bar is a wholesome, nutritious food you already trust. Put them together and you get a snack that's healthy through and through, so go ahead and reach for one whenever hunger hits. Available in four flavors at stores near you.
cue: Put them together and you get a snack that's healthy through and through
explanation: Meadowgrain assumes healthy ingredients make a healthy bar. Combined, honey, dates and oil can add up to a lot of sugar and calories, so a bar of good parts isn't automatically an anytime snack.

whyNot.fal_division: Division would go from the bar down to its ingredients; this ad goes the other way, from the ingredients up to the bar.

passage:
Nina: We need to save $200k this year. My list: shorter weekend support hours, slower free shipping, fewer seasonal colors, no printed catalog, and a smaller app team.
Greg: Some of those sting.
Nina: Each one is small, and honestly no customer would notice any single one. So customers won't notice the package either.
cue: no customer would notice any single one. So customers won't notice the package either
explanation: Nina assumes that because each cut is unnoticeable alone, all five together will be too. Small changes can add up to a clearly worse experience once customers run into several at once.

whyNot.fal_division: Nina reasons from the separate cuts up to the whole package, not from the package down to its parts, which would be division.

source: Developer Rob Kessler · Ashford planning hearing
passage: I've heard the concerns about traffic, and I take them seriously; we've added a turn lane to the plan. But let's be realistic. Each new home adds maybe two cars to the road. Two cars is nothing on a street like Elm. So the 200-home development as a whole won't make a meaningful difference to traffic.
cue: So the 200-home development as a whole won't make a meaningful difference to traffic
explanation: Rob argues that because one home's two cars won't matter, the whole development won't either. But 200 homes means roughly 400 more cars, and small amounts add up.

whyNot.fal_hasty_generalization: Rob isn't generalizing from a few homes to all homes; he's assuming a trait of each home, 'negligible', carries over to the whole development.

title: New storage server: reliability
passage: Hi Carla, the parts for the new storage server are in. I picked every component for reliability: the power supply, the controller, both fans and each of the 12 drives is rated at 99% availability or better. With every part that dependable, the server as a whole should give us 99% availability too, which meets the vendor contract.
cue: With every part that dependable, the server as a whole should give us 99% availability too
explanation: Ivan assumes reliable parts make an equally reliable whole. Without redundancy, the server goes down when any one of its 16 parts fails, so overall availability can be well below any single part's.

whyNot.fal_division: Ivan reasons from the components up to the server; division would run the other way, from the server down to its components.

passage: My morning stack, since so many of you asked! Vitamin D, fish oil, turmeric, ashwagandha, St. John's wort and a high-dose B complex. I researched every single one, and each is considered safe at its recommended dose. So taking all six together is perfectly safe, too. Links to my favorite brands below.
cue: So taking all six together is perfectly safe, too.
explanation: Brooke assumes that because each supplement is safe alone, the combination is safe. Supplements can interact with each other and with medications, so the safety of each part doesn't settle the safety of the stack.

whyNot.fal_hasty_generalization: Brooke isn't generalizing from a few cases to many; she's assuming a trait of each pill carries over to the combination.

title: Finally, a bakery I can trust
passage: I have celiac disease, so I asked a lot of questions before ordering. Every ingredient in the birthday cake is certified gluten-free, and the bakery's kitchen is dedicated: no wheat flour comes through the door at all. Since nothing in it contains gluten and there's no way for it to sneak in, the cake is gluten-free. And it tasted amazing.
cue: the bakery's kitchen is dedicated: no wheat flour comes through the door at all
explanation: Being gluten-free is a trait that does pass from ingredients to cake, as long as nothing else adds gluten. Avery checks that too, by confirming the kitchen is dedicated.

whyNot.fal_composition: Here the trait really transfers: if every ingredient is gluten-free and cross-contamination is ruled out, the whole cake is too.

title: Lead test results for our building
passage: Good news, neighbors. The city tested the kitchen tap in every one of our 48 units, and all 48 came back below the lead action level. The building's service line was also replaced with copper last year. Since every unit's tap tested below the limit, we can say the building's tap water passed the city's lead test.
cue: The city tested the kitchen tap in every one of our 48 units
explanation: The claim about 'the building's tap water' just sums up every unit's result, and all 48 passed. Because the conclusion covers exactly what was tested, the trait does carry from the parts to the whole.

whyNot.fal_composition: 'Passed' here simply means every unit passed, so going from all the parts to the whole is valid rather than a leap.
